prompts.name: rock
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: game environment base color texture. Generate one square 1024x1024 full-bleed tileable material texture. Weathered Korean mountain granite, medium warm grey with fine quartz mineral flecks, irregular shallow fissures and subtle darker mineral veins. No isolated boulders, moss or grass. Flat rock surface filling the frame. Orthographic surface scan with even diffuse cross-polarized lighting. Fine realistic surface detail, no directional illumination, no cast shadows, no highlights, no vignette. Seamless periodic repeat across both pairs of opposite edges. Single material only, no panels, text, logos, borders or contact sheet. Color image only, not a normal map.
